thesis:
律师收到一条初访线索、分析师读到一个财务数字、管理员看见一次工具调用、广告团队看到一次指标提升，接下来都要问：这条记录足以让我做什么决定？本期四组资料给出了四种不同的答案。接通电话不等于适合转介，算对不等于选对公司，留下日志不等于动作获批，试验指标上升也不等于收入增长。

四组材料最值得放在一起读的，是它们各自缺少的对照：未转介的来电里有没有合格线索，算术正确的答复里有没有错引公司，审计流里的调用是否在目标系统生效，以及裁剪后的模型在真实业务中究竟改善了哪个指标。试点应在下游留一份独立记录；如果复核者只能看到助手自己的答案或日志，就没有真正独立的验收。
takeaways: Stretto 的两项百分比用了不同的对照：转化率比较网页线索，每分钟语音成本比较旧语音方案。不能把它们合成一份投资回报率。
FinVeriQA 的算术对照支持把计算交给程序，但当检索错了公司，生成和复核若共用错误材料，两者仍可能一致地答错。
GitHub 的审计流让管理员看见工具调用。要判断一次写入是否获准且生效，还得核对审批和目标系统记录；为此不一定需要收集整段提示词。
广告排序论文将预测误差与数据管道开销分别计量。上线指标没有具名，不应把论文里的正向百分比写成收入或点击率。
contrarian: 企业部署常把“多留日志”当作提高可信度的默认答案。本期的反例是，完整保留一次问答也可能只是完整保留了错公司的证据；记录一次调用，也不等于记录到执行结果。编辑判断：当错误主要来自对象选错、审批缺失或下游未生效时，新增一条可独立核对的业务回执，比留存更多正文更有用。如果同类工单的盲审显示，增加正文在不扩大不当访问的情况下，比独立回执更能降低漏判和复核耗时，这个判断就应修改。

items.title: 电话初访能不能替代表单？先把抽取、分流和律师决定拆开
items.type: 客户与实施方合著的生产案例／产品文档
items.source: 2026-11-18｜Stretto、CI&T 与 AWS 机器学习博客
items.summary: 破产咨询网站原先让访客填写债务金额、是否已有律师和联系方式。律师需要更完整的债务、资产与就业信息，表单一长，访客又容易中途退出。Stretto 把这一步改成电话初访：语音助手先征得同意，再根据来电者的回答追问，结束后交给系统生成结构化记录。团队先把原有十三个字段搬到电话上，才扩大到十八个以上的调查类别。值得注意的是，能把问题问完和有权判断是否承接个案是两件事；通话界面负责收集，律师仍对是否接受线索作最终决定。
items.design: 电话经 Twilio 接入语音桥，Nova 2 Sonic 直接处理双向音频。完整访谈可能需要十五至二十分钟，语音桥在单次会话将到期时另开一条流，带入历史文本，等当前回答结束再切换。通话后，队列把转录文本交给 Claude 3 Haiku 抽取有类型的字段并写入数据库；失败消息保留供重试。系统按律师设定的规则区分合格、不合格和待补资料，再按司法辖区路由。模型调用受身份权限控制，但案例未披露逐字段的访问策略，也未描述热线实时人工接管；不能把律师事后复核说成随时有人监听。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B，客户与实施方合著的生产观察。可核实的是上线顺序、字段入库流程以及规则分流与律师决定的分工。客户称运行约三个月时，线索转化率相对网页表单提高约20%，不是提高二十个百分点；约8分钟是已完成来电的平均时长，约96%是其测试中的抽取准确率，而非整份个案无错率。每分钟语音成本较旧语音方案低95%，依据是二〇二六年四月美国东部指定区域的按需价格，不是每件获接纳线索的总成本。原文没有给出通话样本数、原转化率、各类字段误差或误拒率，也没有独立对照。编辑判断：渠道改换可能改变来客构成，不能把收益都归于语音模型。
items.idea: 给咨询前台做只读的预约资料核对试点，不做资格判断。经同意后收集三项预约信息，记录来电者中途纠正的内容；有冲突则交接待员回拨确认。以全部发起来电为分母，对照表单记录完整且经确认的预约比例、人工回拨分钟数与每份有效预约的总成本，另列放弃率。

items.title: 数字算对了，公司却错了：财报问答要回到哪份原件？
items.type: 学术预印本／开源原型／对照实验
items.summary: 一名研究员分别问英伟达和谷歌母公司的财务问题，助手选对了处理路径，输出的数字也能在计算笔记中找到，但两份回答用的都是另一家公司超威半导体的样本。圣何塞州立大学团队在财报问答原型中公开了这次失败。问题不在于语言模型有没有编一个不存在的数字，而在于它和检查程序相信的是同一份笔记。对需要按公司、报告期和原文交付数据的分析团队，这划出了一条验收线：计算可复现只能说明算式成立，不能说明算式里的数属于这位客户问的对象。
items.design: 用户提出问题后，小模型先区分求数值、查行情、读文本等路径，并识别投资建议请求；路由服务不可用时回退到关键词规则，过程留痕。检索器找申报文件片段，行情工具取报价，由程序算数，写作模型把笔记组织成带引用的短答。检查程序核对引文编号是否存在、数字是否出现在笔记中；不合格的草稿可退回到根据笔记生成的答复。工具接口只读，没有交易动作，但只读并不能阻止引用错公司。论文未证明企业账户隔离或人工审批已投入使用，分析师回查原件应作为另设的发布关口。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B，作者的受控实验、开源实现和五个现场提问记录，未见独立复现或厂商业务收益证明。确认事实：在用程序答案作标准的100道计算题上，写作模型答对29道，程序答对100道；这验证的是给定输入上的算术。五个现场问题中只有两个走智能体模式，两份都通过校验却答错公司，不能据此估算用户总体错误率。研究者另从能在原文逐字定位参考数值的413条记录中抽60条，人为改动证据中的一个数：同读受污染材料的检查发现35%的错误，给检查方正确原文则发现77%。编辑判断：准确定位原件本来就是难题，后一个比例是有理想输入时的结果，不是上线承诺。
items.idea: 给企业研究助理做一个财报数字核对页，首版只接已归档季报中的营收，不回答投资建议。把公司标识、报告期、金额单位和原文位置并排列出，任何一项不符就暂停导出，由分析师对照原件决定是否放行。用刻意混入错公司和错季度的样例统计误放、误拦和每条复核耗时。

items.title: 把编程助手接入审计台之前，先决定是否传送对话原文
items.type: 产品更新与管理员文档
items.source: 2026-11-17｜GitHub 更新日志；配套 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 管理指南

relatedLinks.label: 企业审计流设置与恢复说明

items.summary: 主管想知道工程师让编程助手调用过哪些工具，并不一定需要看到客户工单的原文。GitHub 新增的审计连接让管理员能在微软的同一管理台查看云端、命令行和开发环境里的助手会话。值得留心的是，默认设置会把提示、回复、工具输入和结果一并传过去；企业也可以只传工具名、模型名、时间等活动信息。两种模式能回答的问题不同：要查某种工具有没有被用过，通常无须复制对话；要判断一次调用是否符合工单授权，则还需核对谁批准了什么。
items.design: 启用此公开预览，企业须使用受管用户账户，先打开助手用量记录流，再由管理员通过微软租户身份授权连接。接收端只收编程助手会话事件，不是整个企业审计日志的副本。每条连接可单独关闭原文共享；即使这里关闭，也不能推断其他接收端同样关闭。管理员在管理台查看记录，不需要模型重新生成对话。通用审计流采用至少一次投递，故同一事件可能重复。编辑建议在对账发现缺口时暂停出具结论，先查连接健康与原始业务记录，不能把没有收到记录解释为从未发生调用。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（厂商发布与可核查的配置文档，非独立部署评估）。更新日志证实了连接入口，管理指南进一步限定为公开预览，并列出了原文开关实际影响的字段。通用日志流文档写明每二十四小时做一次健康检查，配置错误须在六天内修复以免丢失事件。这两个数字描述运维机制，不是调用后多久就能查到的承诺。厂商称管理员能跨客户端审阅活动，但未报告各客户端应发与实收事件的分母、重复率或调查节省的人时，本期未见独立测量。编辑判断：控制台显示工具名，不能证明该工具成功改动了工单；若用收到的记录数直接考核员工，还会把重投和不同客户端的使用差异错算成业务产出。
items.idea: 给开发平台与内审团队搭一份只读核对表，用一个测试仓库和虚构工单跑同一组预先登记的工具调用。默认只传元数据，由审批人逐项对照工单的批准范围和最终状态；分客户端记录到达率、重复率、最大延迟及无法归因的条数，不收集员工真实提示，也不自动处分人员。

items.title: 广告排序调参：代理可以挑下一组实验，但不能挑赢家
items.summary: 在广告排序模型之间，一项特征可能由多组模型共同使用。只看单个模型的准确度，容易忽略新增特征背后持续发生的处理与记录费用。Meta 的团队让代理从共享特征池里提出组合，再由实验系统实测预测误差、吞吐量和开销。它不是用语言模型给自己的建议打分，而是挑出下一组值得花算力验证的参数。业务上的取舍很具体：同样的特征数量，优先保留其他模型已经付费维护的信号，可能比一味削减特征更省；如果不能在既定预算内胜过现有版本，就继续使用原模型。
items.design: 输入包括基线特征、既往试验结果、并发名额与资源上限。语言模型先提出交叉特征，工具为候选特征排序；研究代理再调整不同类别的数量，一轮安排十至二十五次异步试验。验证器在训练前拒绝重复、越界或无关参数，调度器把失败记录回填，并提前终止超出资源上限的试验。赢家由事先写定的规则选出：只有满足全部资源约束且误差优于基线，才返回新组合，否则返回原配置。论文报告了上线，但未披露生产发布身份、人工签批或超时后的具体重试安排；试点应将提交实验与批准上线分开授权。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B，生产团队自报的对照实验与线上分流结果，无独立复测。可核查的实验设计是每次训练与基线使用相同数据窗口。七个高影响模型在各自预算内的归一化熵平均下降0.31%；另在六个模型上，相对只按重要性选特征且不裁剪的对照，归因到模型的特征管道成本平均下降2.3%，主任务损失最差增加0.03%，作者判为运行噪声。团队称系统用于优化已超过六个月，并报告线上主要指标提升0.20%，但未给出该指标名称、流量样本量或置信区间。编辑判断：这些分母不能合并，管道成本不是总账单；线上结果也不能被解释成营收增长，更不能据此批准代理自行发布模型。
items.idea: 给推荐系统工程师做一个离线特征试验助手，只在一份冻结的数据上为同一基线提出删减或替换方案。训练脚本统一记下误差、吞吐与资源消耗，超预算立即停；工程师盲审候选报告后决定是否进入灰度。按有效试验比例、每次合格改进花费和回退基线的比例验收。

projectIdeas.title: 财务答案的来源身份证
projectIdeas.description: 给财务分析师做只读核验页：用两家公司相近的指标，刻意交叉替换公司、年份或单位。审核人回到报表确认三项身份再签收，比较拦住错引的比例、误拦率和每题核验分钟数。

projectIdeas.title: 工具调用与业务回执对账
projectIdeas.description: 给企业工具管理员选一个测试库，只执行可撤销的标签更新。以关联编号串起审批、调用和回读结果，由管理员分类缺失与重复事件；记录未生效却报成功的比例和每周对账时间。

en.thesis:
A lawyer gets an intake lead, an analyst sees a financial figure, an administrator sees a tool call and an ads team reports a lift. What decision does each record support? A completed call does not establish suitability for referral; correct arithmetic does not verify the company; a logged call does not prove approval; a better trial metric need not be revenue growth.

Look at the missing comparisons: qualified callers who were not referred, correct calculations based on the wrong company, actions that never reached the target system, and the business metric actually improved by model changes. Keep an independent downstream record. A reviewer confined to the assistant’s answer or log is not making an independent acceptance check.
takeaways: Stretto compared conversion against web leads and voice cost per minute against an older voice solution. These are not one ROI calculation.
FinVeriQA supports delegating arithmetic to code, but a generator and verifier can agree on the wrong company if they share the same mistaken evidence.
GitHub's audit stream exposes calls. Verify authorization and effects against approval and target-system records; collecting full prompts is not always necessary.
The ranking paper measured predictive error separately from data-pipeline costs. Do not label its unnamed online metric as revenue or click-through rate.
en.contrarian: More logging is often assumed to mean more trust. A complete transcript can preserve evidence for the wrong company, and a recorded call need not have succeeded. Our judgment: where entity, approval or downstream effects are the main sources of error, independent receipts are more useful than additional raw content. Revise that view if blinded reviews of comparable cases show that extra content reduces missed errors and review time more than receipts without widening inappropriate access.

projectIdeas.title: Source identity for financial answers
projectIdeas.description: Build a read-only check for analysts using similar metrics for two companies. Deliberately swap entity, year or unit. Require comparison to the filing before sign-off and measure detection, false blocks and minutes per question.

projectIdeas.title: Reconcile calls with business receipts
projectIdeas.description: In one test repository, restrict administrators to reversible label changes. Join approval, call and readback by correlation ID. Classify missing or duplicate events and measure false reports of success and weekly reconciliation time.

items.title: Can a phone interview replace an intake form? Separate extraction, routing and the attorney’s decision
items.type: Joint customer and implementation-team production case / product documentation
items.source: 2026-11-18 | Stretto, CI&T and the AWS Machine Learning Blog
items.summary: A bankruptcy inquiry site used to ask visitors for debt amounts, attorney status and contact details. Attorneys wanted more detail on debts, assets and employment, but people were more likely to abandon a longer form. Stretto switched this step to a phone interview: the voice assistant obtains consent and asks follow-up questions based on the answers, then the system creates a structured record after the call. The team first moved the original thirteen fields to the phone before expanding to more than eighteen intake categories. Finishing the questions does not confer authority to accept a case. The interface collects information; attorneys still make the final decision on leads.
items.design: Twilio connects calls to a voice bridge, and Nova 2 Sonic processes two-way audio. A full interview can take fifteen to twenty minutes. As one streaming session approaches expiry, the bridge opens another, passes the text history, and switches after the current response ends. After the call, a queue sends the transcript to Claude 3 Haiku to extract typed fields for the database; failed messages are retained for retry. Attorney-defined rules distinguish qualified, disqualified and incomplete leads, and qualified leads are routed by jurisdiction. Model access is identity-controlled, but the case does not specify field-level permissions or live human takeover. Post-call attorney review is not continuous human monitoring.
items.evidence: Grade B: a production observation co-authored by the customer and implementers. The rollout sequence, field persistence and division between rules and attorney decisions are documented. After around three months, the customer reported roughly 20% higher conversion relative to the web form, not a twenty-percentage-point gain. About eight minutes is the mean among completed calls; roughly 96% is extraction accuracy in company tests, not error-free case files. The 95% reduction compares per-minute voice costs with the prior voice system at April 2026 on-demand rates in a specified eastern US region, not total cost per accepted lead. Call counts, baseline conversion, field-specific errors, false rejections and independent controls were not reported. Editorial judgment: changing channels may change caller mix; the voice model cannot take credit for the entire gain.
items.idea: Pilot a read-only appointment-data check for a consultation desk, without deciding eligibility. Collect three scheduling fields with consent, logging mid-call corrections; send conflicts to a receptionist for a confirmation call. Using all initiated calls as the denominator, compare confirmed complete appointments, manual callback minutes and total cost per valid appointment with the form. Report abandonment separately.

items.title: Correct arithmetic, wrong company: which filing should verify an answer?
items.source: 2026-11-18 | San José State University research team, arXiv
items.summary: A researcher asked financial questions about NVIDIA and Alphabet. Both questions took the right route, and the figures appeared in the calculation notes. Yet both answers described AMD sample data. The San José State University team documented the failure in its financial QA prototype. The issue was not an invented number: the writer and its validator trusted the same notes. For analysts delivering figures by company, period and filing, reproducible arithmetic shows that a calculation is valid, not that the inputs belong to the company the client asked about.
items.design: A small model routes questions about numbers, prices or text and screens requests for investment advice. If that service is unavailable, keyword rules take over and the fallback is logged. A retriever finds filing passages, a tool fetches quotes, code computes the numbers, and a writer turns notes into short cited answers. The validator checks whether citation identifiers exist and whether figures occur in the notes; rejected drafts can fall back to a notes-based response. The tools are read-only and do not trade, but read-only access cannot prevent wrong-company attribution. Enterprise account isolation and operational human sign-off are not established. An analyst's review of the original filing should be a separate release step.
items.evidence: Evidence grade B: the authors' controlled experiments, open implementation and five live questions, with no independent replication or demonstrated commercial return identified. On 100 calculations scored against programmatic answers, the writer got 29 right and code got 100 right; this tests arithmetic on given inputs. Only two of five live questions used agent mode. Both passed validation and named the wrong company, too few to estimate a population error rate. In a separate study, the team sampled 60 of 413 records whose reference value appeared verbatim in the source, then corrupted a figure in the evidence. The shared-evidence check detected 35% of errors versus 77% when the checker had the correct original passage. Editorial inference: finding that passage is itself hard; the latter rate assumes ideal input and is not a production guarantee.
items.idea: Give enterprise research assistants a checker limited to revenue in archived quarterly filings, with no investment advice. Display company identifier, period, unit and source location together. Block export on a mismatch until an analyst checks the original. Seed test cases with wrong companies and quarters; measure erroneous releases, false blocks and review time per figure.

items.title: Before streaming coding-agent audit logs, decide whether to send the conversation
items.source: 2026-11-17 | GitHub Changelog and GitHub Enterprise Cloud administration guide
items.summary: A manager who wants to know which tools engineers used does not necessarily need a copy of a customer ticket. GitHub's new audit connection lets administrators review cloud, command-line and IDE assistant sessions in one Microsoft console. The default sends prompts, replies, tool inputs and results. An enterprise can instead send activity metadata, including tool and model names and dates. These modes answer different questions: checking whether a tool was used usually does not require copying the conversation; checking whether a particular call fell within a ticket's authorization also requires knowing who approved what.
items.design: This public preview requires enterprise-managed users. The enterprise enables Copilot usage records streaming, then an administrator authorizes the connection through the Microsoft tenant. The destination receives only Copilot agent session events, not a copy of every enterprise audit event. Raw content can be disabled per connection; disabling it here says nothing about other destinations. Administrators inspect records without asking a model to reconstruct conversations. The general audit stream uses at-least-once delivery, so duplicates are possible. Our recommendation: suspend conclusions when reconciliation reveals a gap. Check the connection and source records before treating a missing event as proof that a call never happened.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: B (vendor release and verifiable configuration documentation, not an independent deployment evaluation). The changelog establishes availability; the guide identifies the feature as a public preview and specifies the fields governed by the raw-content switch. The general streaming guide specifies health checks every 24 hours and six days to fix misconfiguration before events may be lost. Those figures describe operations, not a deadline for individual calls to appear. The vendor advertises cross-client visibility but does not give expected versus received event counts by client, duplicate rates or investigator time saved. We found no independent measurement. Our judgment: a tool name in a console does not prove that a ticket changed. Counting records as employee output would also count redelivery and differences in how clients are used.
items.idea: Give platform engineering and internal audit a read-only reconciliation sheet. Use one test repository, fictional tickets and a preregistered set of tool calls. Stream metadata by default. A reviewer compares calls with approved ticket scope and final state. Report arrival rate, duplicates, maximum delay and unattributable calls by client; collect no real staff prompts and trigger no disciplinary action.

items.title: Tuning ad rankings: the agent picks the next experiment, not the winner
items.source: 2026-11-19 | Meta research team, first arXiv version (UTC)
items.summary: Several ad-ranking models can use the same feature. Looking only at one model’s accuracy overlooks the ongoing processing and logging cost of new inputs. Meta’s team lets agents propose combinations from a shared feature pool; the experimentation system measures prediction error, throughput and resource use. The language model chooses which settings deserve compute, rather than grading its own proposals. At a fixed feature count, retaining a signal that other models already pay to maintain can be cheaper than simply shrinking the feature set. If nothing beats the incumbent within budget, the old configuration stays.
items.design: Inputs include baseline features, trial history, available slots and resource caps. A language model proposes feature crosses; tools rank candidates; a researcher agent adjusts volumes by category across 10–25 asynchronous trials. A validator rejects duplicates, out-of-range values and out-of-scope parameters before training. The scheduler records failures and stops over-budget trials early. A predetermined rule returns a new combination only if it beats baseline error and satisfies every cap; otherwise it returns the baseline. The authors report launches but do not specify deployment identities, human sign-off or timeout retries. A pilot should give experiment submission and production approval separate permissions.
items.evidence: Grade B: production-team comparisons and online split-test results, not independently replicated. Trials used the same training window as their controls. Across seven high-impact models, normalized entropy fell 0.31% on average within each model’s budget. In a separate six-model comparison against an untrimmed importance-only control, attributed feature-pipeline cost fell 2.3% on average; main-task loss worsened by at most 0.03%, within what the authors call run-to-run noise. The team reports more than six months of optimization and a 0.20% improvement in a primary online metric, without naming it or reporting traffic counts or a confidence interval. The denominators cannot be pooled: attributed pipeline cost is not the total bill, and the online result is neither a revenue estimate nor grounds for autonomous releases.
items.idea: Build an offline feature-trial assistant for a recommender team. Let it suggest deletions or substitutions against one baseline on a frozen dataset. A training script records error, throughput and resources, stopping over-budget trials. Engineers review blinded reports before deciding whether to test on limited traffic. Measure the share of valid trials, spend per qualifying improvement and the proportion of searches that revert to baseline.
